remarks: Large studio apartment rarely available in boutique Condo building in the heart of SONO. Apartment has high ceilings, exposed brick and wood floors. There are 3 closets, one of which is a walk-in closet. Additional linen closet in bathroom. Kitchen has stainless steel appliances, stove, refrigerator, microwave and dishwasher as well as a pantry closet and breakfast bar. Laundry room and fitness room are located on the same floor as the apartment. Elevator Building. There is also one storage unit on the floor for your extra belongings. Spend the Spring, Summer and Fall on the amazing Roof Deck with Direct Water Views. On site parking for one vehicle included in the rent, Too good to last! Make an appointment to view this great apartment.

facts.laundryLoc: Laundry located on the same floor
